name: Narutomaki Hichou ~Tsuukai Gag Aventure~
original_name: 鳴門巻秘帖　～痛快ぎゃぐあばんちゅーる～
source:
Akatsunenosuke is a master swordsman girl in Edo period. She works for detective agency. Once she got a request to deliver a small box with documents to Futura clan castle. A trivial request turns into a big adventure.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
赤常之助是江户时代的一名女剑术高手，在一家侦探事务所任职。一天，她接到委托，要把装有文件的小盒子送往芙图拉一族的城堡。一件微不足道的差事，就此演变成一场大冒险。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
